name: showhow
description: Narrated tutorial videos, product trailers and written guides of any web app, made by an agent from the live app.

interface.shortDescription: Narrated videos and guides of any web app.
interface.longDescription: Explore a web app in a real browser, mock private data, script and narrate a walkthrough, and render a captioned video with chapters, motion graphics and a written guide with screenshots. Tutorials, deep-dive guides, marketing videos and executive trailers, landscape or vertical.
defaultPrompt: Make a tutorial of how to invite a teammate in this app.
Explain how this feature works, as a video and a guide.
Make a 45-second vertical promo of this product.
